text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected for control-plane dependencies (auth + org-lookup). Spike started ~12:04 UTC. Symptoms: 502/504 from gateway, timeouts to auth-service and org-lookup. Affected routes: /v1/auth/token, /v1/org/* . Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/ctrlplane/5xx-spike

mike: paging oncall — seeing gateway 502s to auth, trend started ~12:03. Customer impact: user-facing token exchanges failing (~30% errors). Logs: repeated upstream timeout. :eyes:

sara: on it, looking at auth pods now. grabbing logs.

raj: i can join live debugging, standing by.

sara: quick tail: ```kubectl logs -n controlplane deploy/auth-service -c main --since=15m | tail -n 60
ERROR timeout after 10s waiting for upstream
WARN conn reset by peer
ERROR upstream returned 502
```

mike: thanks. gateway config shows upstreamTimeout=10s, and instances are flapping. load average on auth nodes is high.

julia: possible cause — config service recently rolled out feature flag for schema validation that fans out to org-lookup. If org-lookup latencies increased, auth might be queueing. checking config rollout.

kim: i see a config push at 11:58 (cfg-service v2.7.1) that touched org-lookup clients. Correlates with spike.

oncall-bob: i'm paged, joining. :wave: quick ask — is impact limited to a region?

mike: mostly seen in us-east and eu-west regions. us-west looks OK so far.

ops-bot: INC created: INC-2026-1427 | Priority: P1 | Impact: token errors ~30% of auth requests | Owners: control-plane oncall.

mike: immediate mitigation plan: 1) increase auth replicas 2) widen gateway timeout 3) temporarily disable new schema validation feature flag 4) route traffic away from affected org-lookup instances (if feasible) 5) monitor error rate.

sara: running scale now: ```kubectl scale deployment auth-service -n controlplane --replicas=10```

deploy-bot: scaling auth-service -> 10 requested, rollout started.

mike: patching gateway timeout to 30s to avoid transient 504s: ```kubectl patch configmap gateway-config -n controlplane -p '{"data":{"upstreamTimeout":"30s"}}'```

julia: disabling schema flag via featureflag service: ```ffctl set org-lookup.schema-validation false --env=prod```

kim: rolling back config push is risky (many clients). disabling flag is safer.

sara: after scaling + flag disable + timeout increase, error rate dropped from 30% -> ~7% in 8 minutes. still seeing some 502s for specific org ids.

mike: good. next step: identify hot org IDs causing timeouts. adding verbose logging for heavy org requests.

raj: grabbing slow queries from org-lookup: ```select org_id, avg(latency_ms) from requests where ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' group by org_id order by avg desc limit 20;``` results: org_538, org_92 have avg 2.4s and 1.8s and high qps.

mike: can we apply a rate-limit for heavy orgs at gateway to protect auth?

julia: yes, we can add per-org throttles temporarily. i'll push rule for org_538 and org_92 -> cap 20 rps.

ops-bot: mitigation update logged to INC-2026-1427.

sara: monitoring: error rate now ~3.2% across control-plane, auth errors trending down. customers with long-running flows may still see hiccups.

oncall-bob: taking ownership for handoff — summary: root likely config-driven increase in org-lookup latency causing auth backlog. Immediate mitigations applied: scaled auth ->10, gateway timeout ->30s, disabled schema validation flag, per-org throttles for hot orgs. Next actions: run perf blast on org-lookup to reproduce, consider rollback of config if latency persists, create runbook entry.

mike: noted. i'll prepare a short post-incident note and list rollback candidate (cfg-service v2.7.1).

julia: opened a tracking ticket: CP-6789 "Investigate schema validation perf regression" and added steps to repro and perf test.

raj: leaving for now — ping me if we need a config rollback.

oncall-bob: handing to day shift @sara at 13:00 UTC for ongoing verification. Handoff notes: monitor 5xx <1%, confirm no customer escalations, keep org throttles until org-lookup fixes deployed.

sara: handoff accepted. I'll run through checklist and update INC.

mike: :white_check_mark: thanks everyone. please add any customer-facing notes to the incident ticket; early message to support drafted: "We observed elevated token errors impacting some customers between 12:03-12:40 UTC due to increased latency in downstream org-lookup service; mitigations applied and error rates reduced. Follow-up investigations underway."

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1427 updated: status -> "stabilized (mitigations applied)".

incident-bot: :information_source: Postmortem owners assigned: julia, mike. ETA prelim timeline by EOD.

sara: leaving final watch until 13:30 UTC, will escalate if errors rebound.

oncall-bob: closing live pager. handoff complete. :handshake:

mike: adding final metrics to INC and linking dashboards.
